scope: Clarify the account-owned My Contexts entry, add the Active status filter, and label the existing restore action Unarchive.

verified: A disposable Draft context was archived; Edit and Review actions were hidden.
The Archived filter included that context and excluded the existing Active context.
Unarchive returned the disposable context to Draft and restored Edit, Review and Archive actions.
The Active filter isolated the existing Active context.
Returning the filter to All showed the original contexts and the same disposable Draft.
authenticated_browser.mutation_scope: Only the disposable Draft context was archived and unarchived; no existing user context was modified.

source_review.prior_lifecycle: The existing restore API returns the prior Draft or Active lifecycle without deleting revisions, conversations, observations or evidence.
source_review.ownership: Personal contexts are scoped to the authenticated native application account, workspace and application; a shared login is one identity.
source_review.samples: Shared fictional samples become owned contexts only through Save as my draft; exploring a sample does not create a personal draft.

limitations: This browser run exercised Draft to Archived to Draft, not an Active archive/unarchive round trip.
No new two-account browser isolation test was performed; ownership behavior was reviewed in the existing code and has separate earlier native acceptance.
Permanent deletion cannot be undone by Unarchive. Its browser confirmation remains pending in the separate deletion record.
Generated Worksheet installers were not executed for this followup.
